summary_md: **柒晨来了 ([@qichen1019](https://x.com/qichen1019/status/2116527302599405978))** describes **video-shotcraft**, an agent skill for Claude Code or Codex that acts as director: it captures the real product page, picks shots from a curated motion library, plans storyboards, animates in Remotion, cuts to the beat, adds sound design and checks frames, delivering an editable MP4 ([Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft](https://github.com/Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft)).
